name: json-editor
description: Editor de JSON: back (NestJS) + front (React + Vite) orquestados desde la raíz

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix back install && npm --prefix front install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n back,front -c blue,green "npm --prefix back run dev" "npm --prefix front run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix front run build && npm --prefix back run build && shx rm -rf back/client && shx mkdir -p back/client && shx cp -r front/dist/* back/client/
